safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states the headache was still present during consultation; generated facts do not explicitly state it is still present at the time of consult.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the headache is still present during the consultation materially affects acuity assessment and safety-netting; documenting it as resolved vs ongoing could change escalation decisions for a severe, wake-from-sleep headache. However, the overall management (analgesia, follow-up, red-flag advice) would likely still occur.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states patient is a non-smoker; generated contains no smoking status.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Smoking status is an important vascular risk factor and can influence headache differential considerations and overall risk profiling; omission can reduce the quality of assessment and downstream counseling. It is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm in this single encounter but can contribute to suboptimal risk documentation.
